tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /maṇḍal sya pañdzi ka saṃ gra ha su bha ṣā mṛ ta hṛ da nā ma bi ha ra tisma// ༄༅/ /maṇḍal gyi dmigs rim legs bshad bdud rtsi'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badzra dha rā ya/ bde stong dbyer med ye shes zab yangs las/ /sna tshogs sku yi rlabs phreng rtag par g.yo/ /dge legs nor bu'i dpal ster skyabs kyi mchog /drin chen bla ma spyi bo'i rgyan du bcing / /de la 'dir maṇḍal gyi dmigs rim rje bla ma'i gsung rgyun mdo tsam bri bar bya'o/ /de'ang sngon 'gro bsags sbyang gnad smin ma byas na dngos gzhi'i skabs su gdams ngag zab mo ji lta bu zhig nyams su blangs kyang ting nge 'dzin rnal ma mi skye bas sngon du bsags sbyang bya ba ni med thabs med zhig yin la/ tshogs bsags pa la'ang maṇḍal la brten pa ni gzhan las lhag pa yin te/ zang zing gis tshogs bsags pa phal cher ni sbyor ba rtsol sgrub kyi dus sdig pa'i dri ma/ dngos gzhi 'bul ba'i dus ser sna'i dri ma/ rjes phul zin pa'i dus rlom sems dang snyems pa'i dri ma gsum gyis gos pas tshogs rdzogs dka' la/ maṇḍal ni dri ma de gsum ka med pas tshegs chung ngus tshogs chen po rdzogs pa'i thabs khyad par can yin gsungs/ maṇḍal gyi rgyu ni rab gser dngul zangs sogs dang / tha ma shing sa rdo sogs las bya/ che chung gi tshad shing sogs yin na khru gang las mi chung ba nges par dgos shing gser dngul yin na gang 'byor bya/ 'god rgyu'i tshom bu yang rab rin po che'i phye ma/ 'bring sman 'bru sna tshogs/ tha ma nas gro sogs 'bru rigs slad med dri bzang gi chu'i rlan ldan/ shin tu bya btang ba lta bu 'byor pa med na rdo dkar srin med pas kyang chog ste/ rgya gar gyi dur khrod 'u 'u ri'i gnas su shin tu bya btang ba'i rnal 'byor pa zhig gis rdo dkar rkyang pas maṇḍal phul ba kho nas grub pa brnyes te lus ma spang par mkha' spyod du byon pa'i lo rgyus ltar ro/

/'bul tshul ni thog mar sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad lhag med du dag par gyur cig snyam pas yi ge brgya pa bzla bzhin pa'i ngang nas lag g.yon gyis maṇḍal bzung / g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis me tog cung zad bzung nas 'khrig mas yun ring du shin tu dag par phyi dgos te/ ma dag pa cung zad re tsam yod na yang rang sems kyi sgrib pa mi 'dag pa dang / shin tu dag par phyis na sgrib pa dag pa'i rten 'brel gyi gnad yod do/ /de nas sgo gsum 'jug pa chig dril te/ lus kyis tshom bu 'god pa/ ngag gis tshig brjod pa dang mnyam du sems kyis 'chad 'gyur gyi dmigs pa rnams lam gyis grub par bsam pa rnams chab gcig tu bya/ de yang sems can spyi mthun gyi las kyis grub pa'i ri gling sogs min par/ rgyu rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ rnam pa ri gling sogs zhing khams kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa/ ngo bo bde stong dbyer med kyi rang bzhin du bsam dgos gsungs/ thog mar dri bzang gi chu cung zad blugs nas gung srin gyis dbang ldan du khrid nas gru bzhir phye ma med par byug la oṃ badzra bhu mi sogs brjod/ de'i tshe 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor rngams su dpag tshad sa ya drug 'bum rgyar grangs med pa/ de'i steng du gser gyi snying po can gyi mtsho rngams su dpag tshad 'bum phrag brgyad pa/ de'i steng du dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi rngams su dpag tshad sum 'bum nyi khri yod pa/ de gnyis ka'i rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu gnyis stong phrag gsum brgya phrag phyed dang lnga yod pa rnams lam gyis grub par bsam/ yang zlum por bskor la oṃ badzra re khe sogs brjod la sa gzhi de'i steng gi mthar phyi'i lcags ris bskor bar bsam/ hūm̐ zhes pa'i tshe gnas srung gi tshom bu bkod/ de nas ri'i rgyal po sogs brjod pa dang bstun tshom bu phyag len ltar 'god/

'god tshul yang chang mjug nas blugs na ma gus par 'gyur bas chang mgo 'am sor mo lnga bsdus kyi rtse nas 'god/ ri rab ces brjod pa'i tshe dbus der ri rab bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa dpag tshad brgyad khri mtshor nub pa brgyad khri gyen du 'phags pa/ shar shel lho baiḍūrya nub padma rā ga byang gser las grub pa'i mtha' bskor du gser ri bdun rim bzhin bzhi khri sogs phyed phyed kyis dma' ba/ bar rnams su rol mtsho mdun la zhing rim bzhin dang po brgyad khri nas phyed phyed chung ba rnams dang / ri rab kyi steng du sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha yi bkod pa dang / bang rim bzhi gser ri bdun gyi steng du rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha yi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / ri rab kyi bar snang nas yar rim bzhin 'thab dral/ dga' ldan 'phrul dga' gzhan 'phrul dbang byed de 'dod pa'i lha rnams dang / tshangs ris nas 'og min gyi bar gyi gzugs khams kyi lha'i bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa yongs rdzogs lam gyis grub par bsam/ shar lus 'phags zhes pa'i tshe shar gling dkar po dbyibs zla gam bcad kha chung ba la dpag tshad sum brgya lnga bcu yod pa lcags ri la bstan cing ngos gzhan gsum la stong phrag gnyis re yod pa/ de bzhin du lho gling sngon po so ga ngos chung shos lcags ri la bstan pa la dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi/ ngos gzhan gsum la stong phrag gnyis re yod pa/ nub gling dmar po zlum po dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad kyis 'khor ba/ byang gling ser po gru bzhi pa ngos re la dpag tshad nyis stong re yod pa/ gling phran brgyad kyang rang gling las chung ba ma gtogs 'dra zhing gling de thams cad phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dge bcu'i dpal dang ldan pa ste/ de'ang / khang sa zhing sa sa yi dge /khang shing 'bud shing shing gi dge /zhing chu btung chu chu yi dge /khang rdo 'thag rdo rdo yi dge /gam 'brog rgyang 'brog rtswa yi dge

/zhes so/ /nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad khyad gzhi dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad dang ldan zhing / khyad chos mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun dang 'khor lo chen po bzhi dang ldan pa theg pa chen po'i rigs can dbang po rnon po sha stag tu gyur pas gang bar bsam/ yon tan bdun ni/ rigs ldan gzugs bzang longs spyod che/ /shes rab phun tshogs dbang phyug ldan/ /nad med shin tu tshe ring ba/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun zhes gsungs/ /zhes so/ /'khor lo chen po bzhi ni/ mthun par gyur pa'i yul du gnas pa dang / /skyes bu dam pa la ni bsten pa dang / /bdag nyid legs smon sngon yang bsod nams byas/ /'khor lo chen po bzhi ni khyed la mnga'/ /zhes so/ /rin po che'i ri bo zhes pa'i tshe shar gling gsum gyi nang thams cad rin po che sna bdun gyi ri grangs med pas mdzes par gyur par bsam/ de bzhin du lho gling gsum gyi nang thams cad shing yal ga lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu rnams rin po che sna tshogs spel ma byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang ba/ nub gling gsum gyi nang thams cad 'dod 'jos kyi ba rwa dang rmig pa ind+ra ni la'i mdog can spu re re nas ji 'dod 'byung ba sogs yon tan kun gyi khyu yis gang ba/ byang gling gsum gyi nang thams cad ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sa lu sogs lo tog phun sum tshogs pa ji ltar brngas kyang slar skye bas yongs su gang bar bsam/ 'khor lo rin po che zhes pa'i tshe shar gling gi steng gi bar snang thams cad du gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa/ gling bzhi dbang du bsdu nus pa grangs med pas gang ba/ de bzhin du lho gling gi steng gi nam mkhar dgos 'dod thams cad kyi char 'bebs shing 'od kyis dpag tshad sogs snang bar byed pa nad kun sel nus pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang ba/ nub gling gi steng gi bar snang thams cad du gzugs mdzes shing blta na sdug pa ji 'dod kyi reg bya can phrag dog dang mig ser chung ba sogs yon tan dang ldan pa'i btsun mo rin po che grangs med pas gang ba/

byang gling gi steng gi nam mkhar des shing mdzangs pas 'og gi gter mthong ba/ rgyal po'i bka' thams cad chos bzhin du sgrub nus pa'i blon po rin po che grangs med pas gang ba/ shar lho'i steng gi bar snang du yan lag thams cad legs par sa la gnas pa gangs kyi ri bo 'gro shes pa lta bu pha rol gyi dgra sde 'joms pa'i glang po che mang pos gang ba/ lho nub kyi steng gi nam mkhar gling bzhi nyin phyed tsam gyis 'khor nus shing bsam pa ltar byed pa'i rta cang shes mdzes pa brgya stong gis gang ba/ nub byang gi nam mkha' la pha rol gyi dgra sde thams cad gnod 'tshe med par choms nus pa'i dpa' stobs dang ldan pa'i dmag dpon rin po che grangs med pas gang ba/ byang shar gyi steng gi bar snang du 'dod dgu thams cad mi zad par len du yod pa'i gter chen po'i bum pa ras bzang gis mgul dkris dang dpag bsam gyi shing gi kha rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar bsam/ sgeg pa ma sogs kyi tshe gser ri phyi ma drug gi steng gi bar snang thams cad du sgeg sogs mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad kun rig las 'byung ba ltar rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ zag med kyi bde ba bskyed pa'i nyams 'gyur du ma dang bcas bzhengs stabs kyis 'khod pa grangs med pa sprin phung 'khrig pa ltar bsam/ nyi ma zhes pa'i tshe gnya' shing 'dzin gyis steng du rgyu nor bu me shel las grub pa dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig yod pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor tsha zer 'od kyis phyogs kun khyab pa gcig bsam/ de bzhin du nub ngos su nor bu chu shel las grub pa dpag tshad lnga bcu yod pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsil zer gyis phyogs kun khyab pa gcig bsam/ lho ngos kyi steng thams cad du gser gyi yu ba dang nor bu rin po che'i tog can lha yi gos dang rin po che'i 'phyang 'phrul du mas khor yug can gyi rin po che'i gdugs brgya stong du mas gang ba/

byang ngos kyi steng thams cad du lha rdzas kyi gos sna tshogs kyis spras pa yid bzhin nor bu'i tog dang gser gyi yu ba can gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan grangs med pas gang ba rnams lam gyis grub par bsam/ de nas 'bru cung zad phyogs thams cad du bkram la lha dang mi yi dpal 'byor sogs brjod tshe ri gling de dag gi steng dang bar snang ji rigs par bkra shis pa'i rtags dang rdzas brgyad/ nye ba'i rgyal srid bdun/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la sogs pa mdor na lha mi'i dpal 'byor mkho rgu yid du 'ong ba ma tshang ba med pas gang bar bsam pa ni gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig yin la/ de lta bu stong phrag gcig gi mthar lcags ri chen po gcig gis bskor ba ni stong dang po spyi phud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya/ yang de 'dra ba stong phrag gcig gi mthar lcags ri chen po gcig gis bskor ba ni stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya/ yang de lta bu stong phrag gcig gi mthar lcags ri chen po gcig gis bskor ba ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po ste/ de dag na gling bzhi nyi zla sogs bye ba phrag brgya 'am dung phyur bcu yod pa de lta bu zhig gsal btab/ de las 'od zer brgya spros pa'i 'od zer re re'i rtse mor rin po che'i padma stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa re re/ de dag gi steng du sngar bsgom pa ltar gyi stong gsum 'jig rten re re/ yang de dag re re las 'od zer brgya re spros pa'i 'od zer re'i rtse na sngar bzhin padma stong gsum dang bcas pa re re/ des mtshon te nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab pa zhig lam gyis bsam/ de'ang chos thams cad bden stong sgyu ma'i 'phrul ltar gdod nas gnas pa'i gnad kyis de dag thams cad go skabs yangs pa dngas gsal 'ja' tshon gyi rang bzhin du gsal la ma 'dres par bkra ba ni dngos po'i mchog yin la/

'bul yul zhing gi mchog rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po rje btsun bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid kyi ye shes sgyu ma'i rol par shar ba'i skyabs yul rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la/ bsam pa'i mchog gzhan don gnyer dang gus 'dun rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis yang dag par 'bul bar bgyi na thugs brtse bas bzhes nas bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib dag cing / mthun rkyen tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam pa'i ngang nas 'bul/ mthar zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum logs su ma grub par sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug gi rol par shes pa'i lta bas rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /de dag ni rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i dbang bzhi ngo sprod las/ zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum/ /gcig tu bsres la gsol ba thob/ /ces gsungs pa'i dgos don yin no gsungs/ de ltar maṇḍal 'bul ba'i skabs su sngar bshad pa ltar gyi dmigs pa sang sang nge ba'i ngang nas rtse gcig tu phul na dngos su de ltar phul ba dang khyad par cung zad tsam yang med pa'i phyir tshogs myur du rdzogs par 'gyur te/ sngon dbul po zhig gis sangs rgyas 'od srung dang mjal tshe rgyu gzhan med par rde'u 'ga' zhig nor bu yin par dmigs nas phul ba'i bsod nams kyis phyis shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la skyes ma thag rin po che'i char bab cing bang mdzod thams cad rin po ches gang ba sogs ngo mtshar ba du ma dang bcas te skyes pas khye'u lha yi rin chen du btags/ nar son pa na rab tu byung ste dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob par gsungs pa bzhin no/ /gzhan du sems rgya yan la btang ste ra gan gor mo zhig gi steng du 'bru ji tsam blugs kyang tshogs mi rdzogs pa'i cis kyang ma g.yeng ba gal che gsungs/

tshogs rdzogs pa la maṇḍal 'di gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa yin pa'i gnad kyis 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas maṇḍal so bdun ma 'di mdzad pa'i mthus chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor thams cad gangs can 'di na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral bar gyur pa dang / so bdun ma 'di grub mtha' ris med du khyab pa yin zhes ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs so/ /de nas maṇḍal lag pa gnyis kyis btegs te slar yang kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin ltar 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad 'di dag tshig rjes don bsgom pa'i sgo nas brjod par bya ste/ de'ang sgrub pa po gang gi yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa'i rdzas ri gling nyi zla bye ba phrag brgya sogs zhing khams rgya mtsho ltar rgya che ba rnams su rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi grangs snyed kyi rgyal srid bdun dang / mchod lha'i tshogs dang / bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun sogs lha mi'i dpal 'byor sna tshogs kyi mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag gis rnam par brgyan pa ni zhing khams gcig yin la/ de las 'od zer brgya 'phros pa'i rtse mor 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gyi padma la gnas pa'i zhing khams re re/ de rnams re res kyang 'od zer brgya brgya 'phros pa'i rtse mor padma dang zhing khams re re yod pas mtshon te/ de lta bu'i rgyan gyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi rtse mo rgya mtsho yi rdul gyi grangs snyed kyi rtse mor rin po che las grub pa'i padmo rin po che'i 'od 'byin pa 'dab ma phyogs kun nas rgyas pa'i snying po stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa la ri gling nyi zla sogs lha dang mi yi 'dod pa'i yon tan rmad du byung ba 'di dag las 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba can bye ba phrag brgya'i grangs ldan re re legs par gnas pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ji lta ba bzhin du sprul te/

de'ang gang gis sprul na chos thams cad rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi rol pa yin pas ci yang 'char du rung ba'i rang bzhin shes pa'i shes rab dang / thabs dad pa dang snying rje chen pos 'gro kun sdug bsngal las bsgral 'dod gnyis zung du 'jug pa kun nas dge ba'i sems kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin gyi dngos po rnam par dag pa 'di/ yul chos kyi dbyings kyis ji ltar khyab pa de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i khams kun kun la khyab cing / dus sems can gyi khams dang chos kyi dbyings kyi mtha' ji srid du gnas pa de srid du rnam par gnas pa'i sgo nas/ zhing gi mchog rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ye shes gcig pu'i rnam par rol pa las byung ba'i chos kyi rgyal po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams/ 'khor rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang / rang rgyal dang nyon mongs pa'i dgra las rnam par rgyal ba dgra bcom pa dang chos skyong nor lha'i tshogs kyis kun nas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu bzhugs pa rnams la dus dang rnam pa kun tu mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod pa lags na thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas kun nas mnyes par gyur cig ces dang / dus deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dngos po bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang dus gsum du bsags shing sog par 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i dngos po ji snyed mchis pa rnams/ ched du bya ba sems can kun gyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don rgyun mi 'chad par bgyid par nus pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ tshul sgo gsum gus pa chen pos/ zhing bla ma rgyal ba sras slob dang bcas pa khyed rnams la dbul bar bgyi na/ sems can thams cad la nyin mtshan dus drug du thugs rje chen pos kun nas gzigs pa'i spyan dang ldan pa gang la yon phul na phan bde'i dpal mi zad par 'byung ba'i yon gnas dam par gyur pa khyed rnams kyis/

bdag la brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ bdag gi mchod pa'i tshogs 'di dag bzhes su gsol bzhes nas sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa sogs 'phral dang yun du bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa rnams kyi don dran bzhin du brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ ni tshogs gnyis kyi nor ster ba gu ru bla ma buddha sangs rgyas bo dhi satwa byang chub sems dpa' sa pa ri wā ra 'khor dang bcas pa ratna maṇḍal rin chen dkyil 'khor pū dza mchod pa me gha sprin sa mu dra rgya mtsho spha ra ṇa 'phro ba sa ma ya dam tshig hūm̐ ni sdug bsngal 'jom pa'i/ don gnyis lhun grub sangs rgyas te/ /de yang tshogs gnyis rdzogs pas thob/ /thabs la mkhas na tshogs myur rdzogs/ /des na tshul 'dir brtson par rigs/ /zhes pa 'di ni don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te skyabs mchog rdo rje 'chang chen po ngag dbang legs pa dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas smin grol rab 'phel gling du gsung ngag rin po che gsung bshad zhib rgyas kyi sgo nas skal ldan gyi slob ma'i tshogs la dga' ston gnang skabs mched grogs 'gas bskul ngor rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis rje bla ma'i gsung gang zin bris pa'i dge ba 'dis kyang tshe rabs thams cad du dpal ldan bla ma dam pas rjes su 'dzin pa dang / don yod rnam bzhis bla ma mnyes par byas nas bka' bzhin sgrub nus par gyur cig/ //maṅgalaṃ// //dge'o// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rnam rgyal/ maṇḍal gyi dmigs rim/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
